method: Ordinary neutral solid renders: six matched triple views, dorsal54/palmar16 pairs, and individual first-web close. Static iterations examined without opposition.
palmar16_note: Matched close sentinel retains its crease; previous hard shelf not visibly reintroduced. Coordinate lock was not required.
new_visible_defects: Angular contour / hard diagonal facet at thumb-root to lower proximal transition, visible in first-web and thenar close.
Unnatural outward bulge at upper ulnar palm in the side view.

iterations.note: 宏观 signed source contour 场；锁住整个 proximal thumb 的突变边界造成虎口底部明显折面。
完整掌面与连续 thumb-root skirt；只恢复 outward contour / palmar fullness 缺额。比其他版本平稳，但仍非正确比例；thumb-root / lower proximal 交界出现角状轮廓。
加强上 thenar palmar envelope 恢复；侧视掌缘外鼓，局部过渡不自然。
7 mm signed source field + 连续过渡；thumb-root 仍形成角状收缩，未恢复自然掌形。
5 mm 三维 source field + 全局连续 thumb pose registration skirt；连接体积变大，但 first-web 开口过窄、底部形成尖角。
